title: What shape is Nepal’s flag? Meet the double pennant
description: Nepal’s flag has two joined triangular pennants, a moon and a sun. Its shape even comes with a precise drawing recipe in the constitution.

sections.title: The outline is the first clue
sections.html:
Nepal’s flag is a double pennant: two joined triangular shapes, one above the other. It has a straight edge beside the flagpole and two points facing away from it. No, the rest of a rectangular flag has not been cropped out.

If you are trying to recognise it in a flag quiz, start there. Before checking a colour or a symbol, follow the outside edge with your eyes. That distinctive outline does a lot of the work.

sections.title: Two colours, two sky clues
sections.html:
The main field is crimson, edged in deep blue. A white moon emblem sits in the upper part; a white sun sits below it. Article 8 of Nepal’s Constitution describes the design.

Here is an easy way to check your memory: which symbol goes at the top? The moon. Remembering that small detail is more useful than staring at the picture until it feels familiar.

sections.title: The constitution includes the drawing instructions
sections.html:
The unexpectedly nerdy part is Schedule 1. It gives a geometric construction for the flag, including the outline, the moon, the sun and the blue border.

There are lines to draw, distances to mark and arcs to construct. The shape is more precise than “draw two triangles and hope for the best”.

Those construction lines are guides, not extra marks to print on the finished flag. Think of the faint pencil work behind a drawing: useful while making it, absent from the final picture.

sections.title: Try looking at shape before colour
sections.html:
That is a handy approach for other flags too. Notice the outline, then the layout, then one distinctive symbol. You have given yourself three small clues instead of one large blur.

For the next round, use our guide to learning world flags or head straight to the quiz. Nepal is a good reminder that the first clue might be around the picture rather than inside it.
